pages.title: Display Circuits
pages.text: Use a redstone block in a display case, a sword in a pedestal, or a $(l:bibliocraft:writing/special_books)redstone book$(/l) in a bookcase as a signal source. A cookie jar pulses when its menu opens. An occupied seat can emit power.

pages.title: Timed Circuits
pages.text: Use the $(l:bibliocraft:furniture/bells_and_clocks)clock editor$(/l) to set redstone times. A desk bell rings when its input gets stronger. A rising signal at the typesetting table stamps the selected title onto a chase.

pages.title: Light from Furniture
pages.text: With display lighting enabled, wooden furniture can shine when you display a luminous block, such as glowstone. It emits the brightest stored block’s light. Removing that block changes the emitted light.
